commit.merge_subject: merge: stable export eta and grade presets

description:
The clip-info sheet gains three settings actions (owner request
2026-11-11 section 4): Copy settings, Paste settings, and a preset
list with Save as preset.

Copy/Paste uses a new in-memory clipboard (GradeClipboard): one
volatile slot, latest copy wins, paste never consumes, and it is
deliberately NOT persisted - process death empties it, which makes
the Paste row simply hide (a persisted clipboard would be a preset
with worse UX). Paste applies through the screen's onGradeChange
path, the exact same write a slider move makes, so the live preview
and persistence behave identically.

Presets are a named GradeK persisted in project.json's new
"presets" section via PresetStore, following the GradeStore/LutStore
pattern: schema-versioned, merge-aware writes that preserve the
grades/sources/exports/luts sections, atomic tmp+rename, corrupt
file falls back to empty, old files without the sect
